title: TDK Extra High Grade T-120 EHG 6 Hour Blank VHS Tape Sealed
categoryName: Consumer Electronics:TV, Video & Home Audio:TV, Video & Audio Accessories:Blank Audio/Video Media:VHS Video Tapes
descriptionText: The TDK Extra High Grade T-120 EHG 6 Hour Blank VHS Tape is a premium grade VHS tape perfect for recording audio and video content. This sealed tape is made by TDK, a trusted brand known for producing high-quality media products, in Japan. With a capacity of 6 hours, this VHS tape is ideal for capturing long recordings without sacrificing audio and video quality. This product is a reliable choice for professionals and enthusiasts looking to record their own content on VHS tape.
